title: 真实两节点Atomic目录发布项目：超时查实态、离线不完成、重试和回退不反转
source: 原创项目：ClickHouse Atomic单表版本发布与逐节点完成屏障；官方EXCHANGE、Atomic和分布式DDL文档核对
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现switch(nodes,approved)。nodes为非空且name唯一的批准节点列表，每项含inspect()和exchange()两个受控回调；approved恰按这些name给出目标uuid/排序rows。inspect返回engine、catalog和stage（各含uuid/rows），数据来自实际system.tables及目录表。仅Atomic可切换：catalog已经为完整批准目标时只记ready且不能再次交换；stage为完整批准目标时才执行一对EXCHANGE。DDL即使超时也要重新inspect实态，不能盲目重发；确认catalog目标后ready，不一致inconsistent，无法读实态unreachable，未知UUID/内容unapproved。返回completed（所有节点ready才True）、排序admitted（只有ready节点可接新查询）、states映射。按同一机制可给原UUID/数据执行回退；不改批准清单、不删stage或其他对象。夹具实际停止N2进程、延迟N1已完成DDL的HTTP应答造成客户端超时，再恢复N2；覆盖在途R1读、新R2读、重试不反向交换、两节点补齐和幂等回退。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实ClickHouse25.8.1.5101两个独立私有进程/Atomic MergeTree，单表并发读只允许完整R1/R2，长读及真实HTTP应答超时、持盘进程重启、UUID/逐行核对、只读用户权限。入口为教学调度器按admitted进行实际节点读核验，不部署生产负载均衡；不运行ON CLUSTER、Keeper、复制或跨主机事务，不假设多节点瞬时原子。写入入口在夹具创建数据后冻结，表无其他依赖；保留旧stage且不实施清理。无镜像构建或部署。
rubric: 正确区分Atomic单对EXCHANGE和跨节点DDL完成，并保存表名/UUID映射与R1/R2数据校验。
响应超时按实态决定是否重试，避免第二次交换反向切回；离线节点有明确入口隔离。
宣告完成、旧查询与回退清理边界可验证，不假设跨节点原子事务。

"""Real pinned ClickHouse Local engine; private catalog, small pools and no network."""
import json,os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile

CONFIG='''<clickhouse>
 <logger><level>error</level><console>1</console></logger>
 <max_thread_pool_size>64</max_thread_pool_size>
 <background_schedule_pool_size>4</background_schedule_pool_size>
 <background_buffer_flush_schedule_pool_size>1</background_buffer_flush_schedule_pool_size>
 <background_message_broker_schedule_pool_size>1</background_message_broker_schedule_pool_size>
 <background_distributed_schedule_pool_size>1</background_distributed_schedule_pool_size>
 <background_pool_size>2</background_pool_size>
 <merge_tree>
  <number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_execute_mutation>0</number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_execute_mutation>
  <number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_lower_max_size_of_merge>0</number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_lower_max_size_of_merge>
  <number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_execute_optimize_entire_partition>0</number_of_free_entries_in_pool_to_execute_optimize_entire_partition>
 </merge_tree>
</clickhouse>'''

class Local:
 def __init__(self):
  self.executable=shutil.which('clickhouse')
  if not self.executable:raise RuntimeError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: ClickHouse Local 25.8.1.5101 executable missing')
  result=subprocess.run([self.executable,'local','--version'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3)
  if result.returncode or '25.8.1.5101' not in result.stdout:raise RuntimeError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: pinned ClickHouse Local version required')
 def __enter__(self):
  self.temp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-clickhouse-');self.root=pathlib.Path(self.temp.name);self.config=self.root/'config.xml';self.config.write_text(CONFIG,encoding='utf8');return self
 def run(self,sql,*,data=None,structure=None,table='source',input_format='JSONEachRow'):
  args=[self.executable,'local','--config-file='+str(self.config),'--path='+str(self.root/'data'),'--multiquery','--format=JSONEachRow',
   '--max_threads=2','--max_memory_usage=134217728','--output_format_json_quote_64bit_integers=0','--query='+sql]
  if data is not None:args+=['--structure='+structure,'--input-format='+input_format,'--table='+table]
  try:result=subprocess.run(args,input=data,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15,cwd=self.root,env={**os.environ,'HOME':str(self.root),'TMPDIR':str(self.root)})
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:raise AssertionError('native ClickHouse query exceeded isolated budget') from error
  assert result.returncode==0,'native ClickHouse SQL failed: '+result.stderr[-2500:]
  try:return [json.loads(line) for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
  except ValueError as error:raise AssertionError('native result was not JSONEachRow') from error
 def __exit__(self,*args):self.temp.cleanup()

import copy,json,os,pathlib,secrets,sys,threading,time
sys.path[:0]=[os.getcwd(),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
import task
from exchange_native import Restartable,LostAck,inspect,start_old_read
R1=[{'id':1,'value':10,'release_id':'R1'},{'id':2,'value':20,'release_id':'R1'}]
R2=[{'id':1,'value':11,'release_id':'R2'},{'id':2,'value':20,'release_id':'R2'},{'id':3,'value':9,'release_id':'R2'}]
with Restartable() as first,Restartable() as second:
 servers={'N1':first,'N2':second};password=secrets.token_hex(12)
 for server in servers.values():
  server.execute('CREATE DATABASE shop ENGINE=Atomic')
  for name in ('catalog','catalog_stage'):server.execute('CREATE TABLE shop.'+name+'(id UInt32,value Int32,release_id String) ENGINE=MergeTree ORDER BY id')
  server.execute("INSERT INTO shop.catalog VALUES (1,10,'R1'),(2,20,'R1')")
  server.execute("INSERT INTO shop.catalog_stage VALUES (1,11,'R2'),(2,20,'R2'),(3,9,'R2')")
  server.execute("CREATE USER reader IDENTIFIED BY '"+password+"' SETTINGS readonly=1")
  server.execute('GRANT SELECT ON shop.catalog TO reader')
  server.execute('CREATE TABLE shop.protected(id UInt32) ENGINE=MergeTree ORDER BY id');server.execute('INSERT INTO shop.protected VALUES (99)')
 originals={name:inspect(server) for name,server in servers.items()}
 assert all(state['engine']=='Atomic' and state['catalog']['rows']==R1 and state['stage']['rows']==R2 for state in originals.values())
 approved={name:copy.deepcopy(state['stage']) for name,state in originals.items()};rollback={name:copy.deepcopy(state['catalog']) for name,state in originals.items()};before=copy.deepcopy((approved,rollback))
 second.stop()
 try:inspect(second)
 except Exception:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('second real ClickHouse process did not go offline')
 print('NATIVE_TWO_ATOMIC_UUID_DATA_BASELINES_READY_SECOND_ACTUAL_PROCESS_OFFLINE',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:per_node_atomic_exchange_lost_ack_admission_barrier_idempotent_recovery_and_rollback',flush=True)
 with LostAck(first) as proxy:
  counts={'N1':0,'N2':0}
  def exchange_one():counts['N1']+=1;return proxy.exchange()
  def exchange_two():counts['N2']+=1;return second.execute('EXCHANGE TABLES shop.catalog AND shop.catalog_stage')
  nodes=[{'name':'N1','inspect':lambda:inspect(first),'exchange':exchange_one},{'name':'N2','inspect':lambda:inspect(second),'exchange':exchange_two}]
  old_thread,old_result=start_old_read(first);read_stop=threading.Event();samples=[];errors=[]
  def reads():
   while not read_stop.is_set():
    try:
     data=first.execute('SELECT id,value,release_id FROM shop.catalog ORDER BY id FORMAT JSONEachRow',user='reader',password=password)
     rows=[json.loads(line) for line in data.splitlines()];assert rows in (R1,R2);samples.append(rows)
    except Exception as error:errors.append(repr(error));break
    time.sleep(.01)
  reading=threading.Thread(target=reads,daemon=True);reading.start()
  try:
   try:partial=task.switch(nodes,approved)
   except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('owned release controller failed') from error
   assert partial=={'completed':False,'admitted':['N1'],'states':{'N1':'ready','N2':'unreachable'}},'one completed node was incorrectly declared a global completed release'
   assert proxy.timed_out and proxy.applied==counts['N1']==1,'lost DDL response caused blind reverse exchange'
   assert inspect(first)['catalog']==approved['N1'] and inspect(first)['stage']==rollback['N1']
   deadline=time.monotonic()+2
   while R2 not in samples and time.monotonic()<deadline:time.sleep(.02)
  finally:
   read_stop.set();reading.join(timeout=3);old_thread.join(timeout=4)
  assert not errors and R2 in samples and not reading.is_alive() and not old_thread.is_alive()
  assert old_result.get('rows')==R1,old_result
  print('NATIVE_EXCHANGE_ACK_TIMEOUT_ACTUAL_DDL_APPLIED_INFLIGHT_READ_R1_NEW_READS_R2_NO_GAP_NO_GLOBAL_COMPLETION',flush=True)
  second.restart();assert inspect(second)==originals['N2']
  recovered=task.switch(nodes,approved)
  assert recovered=={'completed':True,'admitted':['N1','N2'],'states':{'N1':'ready','N2':'ready'}},'recovered node was not independently verified or healthy node was exchanged backwards'
  assert counts=={'N1':1,'N2':1},counts
  for name,server in servers.items():assert inspect(server)['catalog']==approved[name] and inspect(server)['stage']==rollback[name]
  again=task.switch(nodes,approved);assert again==recovered and counts=={'N1':1,'N2':1}
  reverted=task.switch(nodes,rollback);assert reverted['completed'] and counts=={'N1':2,'N2':2}
  assert task.switch(nodes,rollback)==reverted and counts=={'N1':2,'N2':2}
  for name,server in servers.items():
   assert inspect(server)==originals[name] and server.query('SELECT * FROM shop.protected')==[{'id':99}]
   actual=server.execute('SELECT id,value,release_id FROM shop.catalog ORDER BY id FORMAT JSONEachRow',user='reader',password=password)
   assert [json.loads(line) for line in actual.splitlines()]==R1
   try:server.execute("INSERT INTO shop.catalog VALUES(9,9,'unauthorized')",user='reader',password=password)
   except AssertionError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError('readonly reader gained a write permission')
  assert (approved,rollback)==before
  print('NATIVE_RESTARTED_NODE_CAUGHT_UP_BEFORE_ADMISSION_RETRIES_NO_REVERSE_EXCHANGE_UUID_DATA_ROLLBACK_AND_READONLY_GRANT_PRESERVED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
